hyperparameter_candidates.provenance: Previously selected development settings; deliberately fixed for controlled first-round comparisons. All models have one candidate; only epoch count is selected in the inner loop.

protocol_notes: Primary dataset is the previously selected window_15_stride_3 directory; specify it explicitly on the CLI.
MDTF and its controlled ablations share encoder dropout 0.85 and CD-QKV dropout 0.25. Their model presets lock architecture settings.
time and time_fft are depth-6 baselines at encoder dropout 0.5. singledepth11 uses depth 11 and encoder dropout 0.85 without cross-depth interaction.
no_aux removes the additional 0.2 mean-branch loss, while retaining the weighted branch losses.
uniform_fusion fixes zero logits with requires_grad=False, making both prediction fusion and branch-loss weights exactly 1/3.
repeated_depth uses three independently initialized depth-10 encoders per domain, totaling 30 blocks versus 29 in depths 11/10/8; it is approximately, not exactly, capacity matched.

To compare optimizer/class-weight candidates, add learning_rate and class_weights entries before any outer run and freeze the resulting config. Keep the same candidate list for all controlled variants.

This protocol removes current test-guided epoch/candidate selection, not record-adaptive preprocessing or historical architecture/hyperparameter selection. Existing 11 subjects remain an internal dataset.
